Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Bone align is now in the room panel, above Start now, and Unlock movement is a full-width button right below Start now, so both are easy to find. 1.0.97 added big-pack listings, bone align with memory, saved places, free cam, the animation lock (/syn unlock) and popups that show while Synastry is closed, adapted from PoseKit by RaylaPetal with permission.
